Basic Kanji 320 — Stroke Order, Meanings and Example Sentences
All 320 kanji from the MLC (Meguro Language Center) book &quot;Basic Kanji 320&quot; (JLPT N5/N4), in the book&apos;s own order.
For each kanji: the number-and-stroke-order diagram as printed in the book (the small numbers show the order and direction of the strokes), the Japanese (kun) and Chinese (on) readings, the kanji&apos;s own meaning where the book gives one, and the book&apos;s vocabulary with meanings and example sentences. A word with several meanings has one row per meaning.
Notes: Example sentences are exactly as printed in the book, which gives them in Japanese only (no English translation). The small furigana above some kanji and the book&apos;s ★/◆ importance marks are left out.
